matched_data_control.description: Universal Conformer-Small GE2E trained on an exact 5,788-utterance subsample (381 speakers, ~15.2 utts/speaker, seed 42) matching the LibriSpeech total utterance count, evaluated at both 2,400 steps (matched steps & 13.27 epochs to ls_conformer_small_ge2e) and 4,600 steps (matched steps to univ_conformer_small_ge2e).
